_comment: Catalog of kit.blank: what each blank builds. Dimensions are class medians of the style guides (metres, L = along
Y, W = across X, H = up Z); a --like model or --dims replaces them. Parts name the vanilla frames the pieces fill.

automobile.summary: Half body with a MIRROR modifier: wheel arches, belt line, pillars, bumper loops, cut into chassis, bonnet, boot, doors, bumpers and windscreen by a face attribute; plus seats and a dash.
automobile.split: kit.blank_split cuts the parts out (doors per side) and fills the kit slots
notes: a quick start, never the required path: build the body from your own lofted sections when the blank does not fit the design
bodies: sedan, coupe, sports, suv, van, hatchback, wagon, suv_boxy, pickup (kit.blank --body); --wheel-d sets the wheel diameter; --dims is L,W,H in metres
shape the body with soft moves (mesh.transform with falloff) and modifiers; the part regions follow the loops
the tier sets the density of the loops and arch segments

bike.summary: Motorbike or scooter (body sport|scooter): a lofted half body with a MIRROR modifier, fork, handlebar and wheels; the scooter is built around the like model's frames (steering axis inside the leg shield).

bodies.sport: sport bike: tank, seat, tail and fairing loops, a straight fork and bar
bodies.scooter: scooter or moped: rear cowl and floorboard in one loft, a leg shield around the steering axis, seat 10 cm under the rider dummy, headset with lamp and bars, fender and fork arm on the front wheel, engine and muffler ending at the exhaust dummy, rimmed wheels

boat.summary: Half hull with a MIRROR modifier: keel, chine and gunwale loops, a deck line and a windscreen console.

heli.summary: Half fuselage with a MIRROR modifier (cabin pod, tail boom, fin, stabiliser), skid tubes and a rotor mast.

plane.summary: Half fuselage with a MIRROR modifier, a wing, a tailplane and a fin with loops at the control surfaces.

prop_box.summary: A box with edge loops on every axis, one chamfer ring, tiling UVs (metres per repeat) and a flat shading seam on every edge.

prop_cyl.summary: A cylinder with the tier's side count, a ring per cap chamfer and tiling UVs; poles, bins, barrels, hydrants.

building_box.summary: A building box with a floor loop per storey, a bay loop per window column, a plinth, a cornice ledge and a roof slab; tiling UVs.
